key.name: notify-window-reset
key.summary: Notify when a usage window resets
key.description: When true, a desktop notification fires once a 5h or 7d window hands its quota back (detected as a jump in remaining %, since Codex's reset timestamp slides forward while the window is unused).

key.name: show-claude
key.summary: Show the Claude group in the panel
key.description: When false, the Claude icon and percentages are hidden from the top bar. The Claude section stays in the popup.

key.name: show-codex
key.summary: Show the Codex group in the panel
key.description: When false, the Codex icon and percentages are hidden from the top bar. The Codex section stays in the popup.

key.name: claude-panel-windows
key.summary: Which Claude windows to show in the panel
key.description: 'both' shows 5h and 7d, 'session' shows only 5h, 'weekly' shows only 7d.

key.name: codex-panel-windows
key.summary: Which Codex windows to show in the panel
key.description: 'both' shows 5h and 7d, 'session' shows only 5h, 'weekly' shows only 7d.

key.name: panel-colorize
key.summary: Color the panel percentages by remaining %
key.description: When true, panel percentages render green above 50% and smoothly fade through yellow to red as remaining drops below 50%.

key.name: claude-icon
key.summary: Which Claude icon to show in the panel
key.description: 'star' uses the Anthropic Claude starburst mark. 'code' uses the Claude Code bracketed-dots mark.

key.name: show-claude-fable
key.description: When true, adds a "Fable" usage row to the Claude section of the popup and an extra Fable percentage to the Claude panel group. Reads the model-scoped weekly limit whose model display name is "Fable".

key.name: icon-style
key.description: 'color' uses brand colors. 'mono' uses a single panel-friendly grey (#cdd6f4) so the icons blend with the rest of the GNOME top bar.
